items.summary: AURORA, IL / ACCESS Newswire / October 20, 2025 / Old Second Bancorp, Inc. (Nasdaq:OSBC) ("Old Second") has successfully completed its systems and brand conversion of Bancorp Financial's subsidiary bank, Evergreen Bank Group. This marks the final step in its most recent acquisition and underscores 154 years of continuous growth and unwavering commitment to community centered service. As of today, all former Evergreen Bank Group branches are now operating under the Old Second National Bank name. This milestone marks the full integration of Evergreen's locations into Old Second's systems, products, and service offerings. Customers of the Evergreen branches will now benefit from expanded access to Old Second's comprehensive banking solutions, enhanced digital platforms, and a unified customer experience across all locations.
